documents.name: travel_grant_letter_hnovakova.txt
documents.text:
Masaryk University - Faculty of Science
Department of Experimental Biology
Kotlářská 2, 611 37 Brno

To: Mgr. Hana Novaková, doctoral student
Subject: Approval of travel support - Internal Mobility Fund 2026/II

Dear Mgr. Novaková,

we are pleased to inform you that the Faculty Mobility Committee has approved your application for travel support to attend the Central European Biofilm Meeting (Vienna, Austria, 2-4 December 2026), where you will present an oral contribution.

Terms of support:
1. The maximum amount of support is CZK 12,000 (twelve thousand Czech crowns). Costs above this amount must be covered from other sources.
2. Eligible costs: conference registration fee, travel, accommodation, and local public transport. Meals and per diems are not eligible under this call.
3. Travel must be by public ground transport (train or bus), economy class. Air travel and taxi fares are not eligible for a destination of this distance.
4. Conference registration must be completed by 30 October 2026 to qualify for the early registration fee, which is the maximum amount the Fund will reimburse for registration.
5. Original receipts and the completed travel report form must be submitted to the department secretariat (Ms. Jana Pokorná, room 214) within 30 days of your return. Late claims will not be processed.
6. The support of the Faculty Mobility Fund must be acknowledged on the final slide of your presentation.

We wish you a successful presentation.

doc. RNDr. Pavel Holub, Ph.D.
Vice-Dean for Doctoral Studies
Brno, 18 September 2026
